voice.summary: Sounds like a phone manual that finally got a friendly editor: clear numbers, plain tips and a calm tone about charge and wear. It estimates, says so and never promises miracles.
dos: Give percentages and times with units
Label gains in tips as estimates
Explain health in plain words, like capacity left
donts: Do not use tech hype words
Do not hide that values are simulated

taglines: Know your battery, inside and out
Health you can see in a ring
A battery that tells the truth
boilerplate: Nimbus N2 is a smartphone whose battery dashboard shows charge, long-term health and history in one ring, with practical tips that estimate how much life each habit can add.
